title: a close or prove commits only the house paths its own step wrote
intention: close.sh and prove.sh commit, in the cairn house tree, only the paths the step they ran wrote, named, never 'git add -u'; a dirty file the step did not write stays uncommitted for its own hand.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 (ticket 39fdea889714): an uncommitted proof edit sat in the house tree while close.sh ran BUILDME; close.sh's first act, commit_all "hollow sealed, verdict" (close.sh:24), staged it through 'git add -u' (close.sh:15) and committed and pushed it as 38e3f8323 '39fdea889714: hollow sealed, verdict', before BUILDME, which then refused. prove.sh:11 carries the same 'git add -u'. A commit whose subject names a step that did not write its contents is a false record (Law 7), and a step committing a file another hand is mid-way through takes a write that is not its own (Law 6).
traces_to: Law 6 — the owner alone gates writes to it; Law 7 — a record of truth is permanent, so a misattributed commit stays wrong.
how: Hypothesis (outline 0.6.1, CC-answerable): since 79875eb17ac2, 2955a4a316d3 and ee9637b02525 (PROVED 2026-11-19) every crossing commits its own component history.json and state.json, so close.sh's house-side sweep has no records left to land. The builder first measures what each close.sh and prove.sh step writes in the house tree (prove.sh: the sealed validations it already names at prove.sh:19; close.sh: whatever 'bin/cairn cleanup' writes). Each step then stages exactly those named paths (plus .artifact-journal.jsonl when dirty) and commits them with '-- <paths>'; never 'git add -u'. If close.sh's commit_all has no house paths left to commit, its house half is deleted and only the commons line (d3b8cdf81a41) and the pull/push remain. The proof builds a scratch git house repo with an unrelated tracked file dirty, extracts each script's house staging as written, runs it with bash, and reads git status. MEASURED AT BUILD 2026-11-20: 'bin/cairn cleanup' wrote nothing in the house at 9996bf7186e3's PROVED close (37dd9dc28 carried only the crossing records; the tree read clean after), so what a step writes in the house is a seal. The house half therefore stays, narrowed: a selector cairn/devices/cc/scripts/house_paths.py (cwd = house, args <id> <commons>) names the dirty validations/*.json the ticket's plan names or that sit beside a proof it names (top-level writes_to, every decision's writes_to, bounds.in), plus the journal only when one is selected. Source, a proof included, is never selected: 38e3f8323's swept file was an in-scope proof, so scoping by ticket alone would not have caught it. prove.sh's 'git add <validations dir>' (prove.sh:19) is deleted: it staged foreign seals in that dir.

clauses.claim: with an unrelated tracked file dirty in a scratch house repo, every close.sh step's house-side staging, run as written, leaves that file dirty and uncommitted
prove.sh's house-side staging, run the same way, leaves that file dirty and uncommitted
a path the step itself names (prove.sh's sealed validation) still lands committed

decisions.text: D1: close.sh's commit_all stages the house through house_paths.py, never 'git add -u'; the selector is new and lives beside the scripts.
D2: prove.sh's commit_all does the same, and its 'git add <validations dir>' line is deleted; its proof's seal still lands through the selector.
D3: the proof keys PROVES to clauses 1-3, one tooth each, over a scratch git house repo in a tmp dir; red at HEAD (the 'git add -u' sweeps the unrelated file).

measured.saw: 38e3f8323 '39fdea889714: hollow sealed, verdict' carried cairn/machines/ticket/proofs/test_a_terminal_ticket_clears_its_ticket_troubles.py, an uncommitted edit, plus its resealed validation; pushed while 39fdea889714 stood at TICKETME, before BUILDME refused
measured.how: git show --stat 38e3f8323 and git log on that proof, read beside close.sh:15 (git add -u) and close.sh:24 (commit_all "hollow sealed, verdict"); prove.sh:11 grep
